_comment: Adapted from EVENTS in Parlour v23.dc.html (line ~1487). PORTING DECISION (see docs/PORTING_NOTES.md): the source's 'rest:nerve' option reward is dead — the 'nerve'/spiral stat was removed from the design in chat11 but these three event option rewards were never migrated off it, so 'foot' text like '+10 nerve now, +2 for the rest of the run' currently does nothing in v23. We ported the flavor text and choice structure unchanged but replaced the reward with a flat faith payout on the affected options (still free, still the 'spend it on yourself / score' vs 'spend it on money' choice the source event was going for), and dropped the foot line that no longer applies. ADDED IN THE PORT, not from the source prototype: the eight events after the third one. The source shipped three ordinary events plus the Minitel demonstrator, which is roughly one event per five knocks of a sixteen-knock run -- the shortage a player notices first (docs/STEAM_RELEASE.md). They follow the source's shape exactly (a head, a title, a line, and two options that trade the evening's money against what the village thinks of you) and are marked `"added": "port"` so the game's author can find and replace them in one search. Options that hand out a card or a mark NAME it rather than carrying a copy; see Run.resolve_named().

events.title: Your own chair, for once
events.body: Twenty minutes before the next one knocks.
events.head: THE BACK ROOM
events.line: Spend them on yourself or on the money.

opts.name: Twenty Minutes
opts.text: You do not think about any of them. Afterwards you can sit with people a little longer than you could.

opts.name: The Evening's Take
opts.text: You go through the saucer twice and find more than you remembered.

events.title: A girl on the stairs, no money
events.body: She has been waiting since the last one went in.
events.head: SHE CANNOT PAY
events.line: She wants to know whether her brother is coming back.

opts.name: For Nothing
opts.text: You tell her the truth in the kindest order you can find. She goes home lighter and tells nobody who did it.

opts.name: The Full Rate
opts.text: She comes back an hour later with the coins in a handkerchief. You read the same cards.

events.title: A card came out of the deck wrong
events.body: It was face up in the pack before you shuffled.
events.head: THE MISDEAL
events.line: Something in the deck is not doing what you asked it to.

opts.name: Burn It
opts.text: Take the weakest thing in your deck out of it for good. You do it in the grate yourself.

opts.name: Let It Lie
opts.text: You put it back in the middle and decide not to think about it any further tonight.

events.head: SHE IS BACK
events.title: The gendarme's wife, twice this week
events.body: She asks the same question she asked on Tuesday.
events.line: You already know what she wants you to say.

opts.name: The Same Answer
opts.text: You say it the same way, slowly, and let her hear herself agree with it. She goes home and does nothing, again, and thinks better of you.

opts.name: Not Tonight
opts.text: You tell her you have nothing new and refuse the coins. She leaves them on the cloth anyway.

events.head: THE RENT
events.title: He waits at the gate until you come out
events.body: The landlord has heard you are doing well.
events.line: He is not unkind about it, which is worse.

opts.name: In Front Of The Neighbours
opts.text: You count it into his hand at the gate where anyone can see. He is embarrassed and the village decides he was the one in the wrong.

opts.name: Two More Nights
opts.text: He agrees, because he always does. You keep the money and something small goes out of your voice.

events.head: IT KEEPS COMING UP
events.title: The same card, four evenings running
events.body: You have started to shuffle around it without meaning to.
events.line: A deck does not have opinions. This one is developing something like one.

opts.name: Let It In
opts.text: You stop fighting it and put another one in beside it.

opts.name: Take Something Out Instead
opts.text: If the deck wants to be smaller, you can oblige it. The weakest thing in it goes in the grate.

events.head: THE WAKE
events.title: They want the cards at the house
events.body: The old man went on Thursday and the family cannot stop talking.
events.line: Nobody has mentioned paying you, and nobody is going to.

opts.name: For The Family
opts.text: You read for three hours in a kitchen full of people and get the daughter to say the thing she came in holding. No money changes hands.

opts.name: The Evening's Custom
opts.text: You keep the parlour open instead. Four people come, because a death fills a village with questions.

events.head: YOUR OWN HANDS
events.title: The cold has got into the joints
events.body: You have been shuffling badly all week and pretending not to notice.
events.line: There is a thing your mother used to do about it.

opts.name: Salt And Hot Water
opts.text: It smells like her kitchen and it works, which you resent.

opts.name: It Will Pass
opts.text: You get through the evening on the strength of not admitting anything, which is a skill in itself and pays about as well.

events.head: THE OTHER ONE
events.title: A woman two villages over
events.body: She reads cards as well, and better, and everyone says so.
events.line: She has sent word that she would like to meet you.

opts.name: What She Does Differently
opts.text: She tells you in about four minutes and refuses to take anything for it.

opts.name: Let Her Come To You
opts.text: You stay where you are. Two of her regulars turn up at your door within the fortnight, mostly to see what the fuss is.

events.head: THE ROAD IS UNDER WATER
events.title: Nobody is getting through tonight
events.body: It has rained since Sunday and the bridge is a rumour.
events.line: The evening is yours whether you want it or not.

opts.name: Six Kilometres In The Wet
opts.text: You arrive at the far farm at nine, soaked, and are paid in full and fed. They will tell that story for years.

opts.name: An Evening Off
opts.text: You lay the cards out for nobody and look at them properly for the first time in months.

events.head: HE CANNOT PAY IN COIN
events.title: The carpenter brings a box
events.body: It is a good box. He made it in the week and he made it for this.
events.line: He is very clear that it is not charity in either direction.

opts.name: Something To Keep Them In
opts.text: The cards live in it now, and they come out of it differently.

opts.name: Sell It Yourself
opts.text: You send it back with him and he sells it at the Saturday market, and half of what he gets arrives at your door in an envelope.

events._note: DEMONSTRATOR, paired with the OEIL code in minitel.json. `secret` keeps it out of the ordinary random pool; only Minitel.armed_events() can offer it.
events.title: The number nobody answers
events.body: The screen is still on. You did not leave it on.
events.head: THE MINITEL, LATER
events.line: It has been ringing at the other end for some time.

opts.name: The Other End
opts.text: You sit with it until it stops on its own. Whatever it was, it knows you were there.

opts.name: Not Tonight
opts.text: You put the handset down and unplug the thing at the wall. The evening is quieter and a little poorer.
